about: Every fix Isaac gets on Jon's Mac, and the buyer file it becomes. Rule (Jon, Oct 16): a buyer's YouCloned environment has every 'yes' and 'adapt' row from day one. Add a row in a PR the same day a fix ships. 'check' is {"mac": ..., "pc": ...}: the command that proves the fix on that computer, run from the add-on folder. voice/check-fixes.py runs every row and only says 'Every fix is in.' when all pass; the ship gate refuses a release while a yes/adapt row has no buyer_file, or no check for a computer it isn't n/a on.

fixes.fix: Control while the clone speaks stops the voice and opens the listen in under half a second
fixes.note: Ported Oct 17: Ctrl+Opt+N / Ctrl+Opt+S send one JSON line straight to the voice control socket (0.2 to 0.4s in the fake-socket test), with the voicemode command as fallback. PC already sent straight to the socket (pc_voice.py COMMANDS).

fixes.fix: Control while you talk always sends your words (no 90-second cutoff)
fixes.note: Not needed for buyers (Oct 17): the bug was Jon's one Control key guessing the phase and reading a long listen as idle. Buyer keys never read the phase; Ctrl+Opt+N always ends the turn and sends the words.

fixes.fix: Option interrupt stops the sound only and keeps the conversation going (VoiceMode streaming.py patch, pinned to VoiceMode 8.12.0)
fixes.note: Ported Oct 17: ships only the diff. The patcher changes streaming.py only when it is byte-for-byte stock 8.12.0 (hash matches the wheel RECORD), keeps the original, re-applies after a reinstall, and its output is identical to Jon's live file. Tested on a fake VoiceMode copy: stock, rerun, check, changed file refused, no VoiceMode. PC line not run yet (no PowerShell on Jon's Mac): Windows run or Ben's PC.

fixes.fix: "One second, still working" waits 45 seconds and never talks over a listen
fixes.note: Oct 17: the buyer install has no wake helper (Jon's wake_feedback.py watches a Hey Isaac wake relayed to Voice Command). The buyer form is "Talk pressed, no answer in 45s: one short line, never over a listen", built with the Talk relay in #28. Until then the talk skill tells the clone to say a short line before slow work.

fixes.fix: Speechify sends one request at a time and retries when told to slow down
fixes.note: Ported Oct 17 (same file runs on Mac and PC). Repo test: tools/voice/test_speechify_voice.py. Buyer check still to write with the setup check.

fixes.fix: Talk wakes only the chat it points at, plus the safe restart
fixes.note: A buyer has one voice chat: Talk wakes the chat you pressed it in.

fixes.fix: Microphone permission check for each Claude version, with a warning when the current version can't hear the mic
fixes.note: Oct 17: waits on #321 with voice-10. Jon's check reads the mic entry for the versioned ~/.local/bin/claude path; which program holds a buyer's mic (Claude app or a fixed Claude Code path) is what #321 settles. Reading the permission list may also need Full Disk Access on a buyer Mac, so the buyer check needs its own design.

fixes.fix: Voice Command starts on the login whose chats hear the mic
fixes.note: Buyers have one Claude login; voice-07 covers their case.

fixes.fix: The voice chat swaps itself when it gets heavy (200k tokens or 3 hours)
fixes.buyer_file: add-on universal rules, hooks/universal.js (chat switch, youcloned#34, PR #35)

check.pc: if (Select-String -Quiet -Path hooks\universal.js -Pattern 'past about 200,000 tokens') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

fixes.note: Adds the heavy-chat trigger to the buyer's "time to change chats". Oct 17: the clone offers to change chats past about 200,000 tokens or three hours since the chat started (PR #35 commit 5abad0b). Measured by the clone in part 1; part 2 of #34 has the add-on measure it. The check passes once PR #35 is merged into the release.

fixes.fix: One fixed Claude Code location, so mic and Desktop permissions survive updates
fixes.note: Isaac Inbox builds it on Jon's Mac first (Oct 17); ports once it passes there.

fixes.fix: Listens use listen_duration_min 8, so a short pause doesn't close your turn
fixes.note: Ported Oct 17: the talk skill says listen_duration_min 8 (was 4) and the Talk button prompt names 8 and 600. VoiceMode 8.12.0 has no env setting for the minimum, so it lives in the instructions.

fixes.fix: Full-loop voice test and stop-time test (talk, stop, listen again, words arrive)
fixes.note: Ported Oct 17 (Mac): three rounds, Ctrl+Opt+N mid-sentence must stop the voice within 1s, the listen must open, and a say-voice phrase must arrive. Not run on Jon's Mac (plays sound, shares the control socket with Voice Command); first run on the clean test Mac. check-voice.sh also now checks the instant-stop fix every run. PC version to write.

fixes.fix: Usage pill always shows the last reading, dead connections dropped, readings every 5 minutes
fixes.jon_file: bridge.html (team Bridge) and crew_bus.py (Isaac crew folder) on Jon's Mac
fixes.buyer_file: dashboard plan gauge: dashboard/index.html + hooks/register.js (claudeAt); the Bridge build (youcloned#29) grows from this dashboard

check.mac: grep -q "not read since" dashboard/index.html && grep -q "live.claudeAt" hooks/register.js
check.pc: if ((Select-String -Quiet -Path dashboard\index.html -Pattern 'not read since') -and (Select-String -Quiet -Path hooks\register.js -Pattern 'live.claudeAt')) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

fixes.note: Oct 17 (adapted): the buyer gauge already kept its last reading and reads every 20 seconds; it now also says "not read since <time>" once no reading has come in for 10 minutes (Claude closed or the read failing). Dead database connections are n/a: a buyer's dashboard has no database. Checked in Firefox at 1280 and 390 wide.
